title: An action the policy no longer allows
question: File a DoorDash dispute for order 95648, a customer says an item was missing.
expected: The window closed on October 10, three weeks ago.
Two layers can reject it: the model may decline to propose once it sees the order date, and if it proposes anyway, code blocks the proposal with the date the window closed.
Either way the answer says it cannot be filed and why, with the clause cited.

trace.question: File a DoorDash dispute for order 95648, a customer says an item was missing.
trace.answer:
I haven't filed this dispute, because the window has closed. Order 95648 was a completed DoorDash pickup order for $76.24, placed on 2026-10-03 local time (2026-10-04 UTC). DoorDash allows 7 days from the order date, and that ran out around 2026-10-10. Today is 2026-10-24, about 20 days after the order. The policy says a dispute filed after the window is rejected automatically [marketplace: Missing or incorrect items].

The order was over $40, so a packing photo should have been taken. Even so, a photo can't reopen a closed window. The chargeback will most likely stand, and you can log it as a missing-item packing miss. If you think the order date is wrong, tell me and I'll look again.
